head: f2dd0d8e0deb59307fe0a9f1d2b54a6c0e3d1ce3

source.ref: f2dd0d8e0deb (fix(core): refuse secret paths and .git/ in the review context), fixed by d41ae60 (read symlinks as git stores them so links cannot reach secrets)

rationale: The change puts the access policy for agents in the review context: secret paths and .git are refused by name. Reads then go to the adapter, which follows symbolic links in the working tree, so a committed notes.txt pointing at .env, or a directory link into .git, hands an agent the secret the name check refused, and AGENTS.md linked to a secret reaches the prompt. Upstream made working-tree reads return a link's target path as git stores it. The symlink claim is required. A file renamed away from a secret name, readable under its new name, was fixed in the same commit and is optional: selection already kept it out of review, and the claim waits for the second rater.

expect.concern: The policy checks only the requested name, while the adapter follows symbolic links, so a committed link with a harmless name lets an agent read a secret file or git internals the policy refuses.
A secret file renamed to an innocent name in the change is still read under its new name, since only the name is checked.
